intro.line: Amonkhet, a desert plane of perfect order. Its people train from childhood in the trials, to earn a place in the afterlife.
The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.
I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying. The afterlife will have to wait.
Samut of the Tah crop has stopped believing. She is not alone, but the others do not know it yet.

finale.line: The people entered as worthy. They exited as Eternals.
Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch.
I was promised an afterlife, not this. Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.
The Gatewatch loses, and loses badly. The gods are dead and the city is open to the desert.
Bolas leaves with the largest army of Eternals he could ever want. Samut and the survivors walk out of the Hekma into the wastes.

villainFinale.line: My work here is complete. The people have done everything required of them.
This place has outlived its usefulness.

battles.title: The Tah Crop
battles.blurb: You arrive in Naktamun with Samut, who has begun to doubt the trials. Her old crop-mates are sent to bring her back.

scene.line: Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma? Beyond the reach of the gods? Beyond the horns on the horizon?
Initiates live and train with their crop, the unit that begins the trials together.
Embalm: they can return from the graveyard as a white mummy token. Kill them once, and expect to kill them twice.

villainScene.line: What the gods decree, the mummies enforce.
Hesitation breeds dissension. To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back.

hero.half: Exile them or expect them twice.

battles.title: The Trial of Strength
battles.blurb: Neheb, Samut's brother in all but blood, is training with Hazoret's warriors. First he has to get through Rhonas's trial of beasts and teeth.

scene.line: Ashes can't be embalmed.
To Hazoret, those who fight for her are her beloved children.
Exert: attack hard, and the creature stays tapped through your next untap. Spend it on the turn that wins, not before.

villainScene.line: Everything in the trial has teeth. You will overcome them, or you will feed them.
There are no safe paths through the Trial of Strength.

battles.title: Hapatra's Poisons
battles.blurb: Hapatra, Bontu's vizier of poisons, sits in on Kefnet's trial of puzzles. Everyone is a little too clever and a little too sure.

scene.line: If you fear poisons, it is because you are ignorant of them.
Her subtle smile is suffused with venom.
Aftermath: the bottom half of the split card can only be cast from the graveyard, and then it is exiled. Cast the top half first.

villainScene.line: No amount of strength can help you overcome my trial. You must be ready to forgo your body and favor your mind.
The answers are here. This is the way through the trial.

hero.half: Cast it twice, once from the graveyard.

battles.title: The Trial of Zeal
battles.blurb: Gideon Jura sees an initiate murder his crop-mate in the trial of zeal. His admiration for Naktamun gives way to horror.

scene.line: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.
The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them.
Cycling: pay a little mana, discard the card, draw a new one. Cycle the spare lands and the dead cards.

villainScene.line: When the time comes, only one of you will be honored by my spear.
What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.

battles.title: The Eternals
battles.blurb: In the Hour of Revelation, the gods are dead or turned. The Scarab God, who was Kefnet's last act of defiance, hunts for the dissenters.

scene.line: If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?
The dead entered as worthy. They exited as Eternals.
Eternalize: they come back from the graveyard as 4/4 black Zombies. Exile the graveyard, or kill the Zombie.

villainScene.line: For many years, servant mummies toiled in the mines to extract lazotep. The emergence of the Eternals revealed the sacred substance's true purpose.
The Eternals had long since mastered every technique taught during the trials.

battles.title: Exert Red
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in summer 2017: Temur Exert against Zombies, two ways of surviving the Hour.

scene.line: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.
In Amonkhet's ever-shifting sands, nothing stays buried for long.
Their dead keep coming back. Race them, and exert only when it wins you the game.

villainScene.line: The Curse of Wandering permeated Amonkhet long before Nicol Bolas. He simply harnessed it.

battles.title: God-Pharaoh's Gift
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in summer 2017: Gideon's green-white against the God-Pharaoh's Gift, which turns every creature in your graveyard into a hasty 4/4.

deck.name: God-Pharaoh's Gift
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: When the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon, so begins the Hour of Revelation. Then the Hour of Glory, the Hour of Promise, and finally the Hour of Eternity.
Though the afterlife, the city, and even the God-Pharaoh himself were one great deception, the ideals championed by the gods remain true.
Their Gift is slow but it ends games. Kill the graveyard before it fills.

villainScene.line: The dead perform all the work here, farming, building, teaching, even embalming their fellow mummies.
A single grain of sand is insignificant, but a sandstorm can reduce pyramids to dust.

battles.title: The Hour of Devastation
battles.blurb: Nicol Bolas has the city, the gods, the Eternals and the Hour. The Gatewatch is what is left of the resistance.

scene.line: Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch.
Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?
He cannot be beaten by force. Hold what you can and get the people out.

villainScene.line: I had hoped for more from you, Jace. But I expected as much.
This is what glory looks like.

hero.half: You cannot win this, hold on.

half.line: Everyone, to the Hekma! We can still get out!

battles.title: Ramunap Red
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, the summer red decks ruled the sand.

archive.what: Mono-red decks built to kill by turn four, with Bloodrage Brawler, Earthshaker Khenra, Hazoret the Fervent and a land that kept green decks from playing their lands.
archive.why: Red had the fastest and most reliable plan in Standard for most of that summer.
archive.beat: Kill their small creatures early and keep your life total high enough to take a hit.
archive.after: Ramunap Ruins was banned in Standard in January 2018. It is not in this act's sets, so this tribute plays an ordinary Mountain instead.

deck.name: Ramunap Red
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: To Hazoret, those who fight for her are her beloved children.
This one is fast. Block early and do not take the first hit.

villainScene.line: This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun.

after.line: Recorded: Ramunap Ruins banned in Standard, January 2018.
